[[Map completion]] is the optional activity of visiting all [[Point of Interest|points of interest]], [[vista]]s, [[waypoint]]s and completing all [[renown heart]]s and [[hero challenge]]s within a given [[Open world|open-world]] [[zone]]. After a zone has been completed, the character receives a bonus chest [[#Reward|reward]] and a [[mail]] pertaining to the accomplishment, except for the [[city]] maps. Completing all zones within a certain area like [[Central Tyria]], [[Heart of Maguuma]], [[Elona]], or [[Cantha]] is tied to specific achievements and rewards, mostly related to crafting [[legendary weapon]]s. Additionally, completing all zones in the five [[region]]s of Central Tyria—[[Ascalon]], [[Kryta]], [[Shiverpeak Mountains]], [[Maguuma Jungle]], and [[Ruins of Orr]]—grants [[Map completion#World completion|world completion]] rewards and {{achievement icon|Hero_(achievements)#achievement137|Been There, Done That}} achievement. It is possible to complete most maps without uncovering all of their [[area]]s (those are tracked by the [[region]]al [[Explorer]] achievements); for example, finding most [[jumping puzzle]]s in a zone is not required, since these are in secluded areas without any map objectives to discover. If area is completed while in an [[instance]], such as a [[home instance]], the accomplishment will display the next time the character re-enters the area. For zones with repeatable [[Renown Heart]]s, a single completion of the heart is sufficient to count for the map completion. The rewards for city maps are limited to the standard amount of [[experience]] and a single [[Transmutation Charge]]. The legend at the top left corner of the [[map]] shows the remaining objectives for the [[#World completion|world completion]] (in Central Tyria zones) and the completion of the current zone. Moving the mouse pointer over each entry in the legend will highlight the remaining objectives in the revealed [[area]]s, making them much easier to find. Hovering the mouse over the zone name will similarly display a popup with the zone's completion percentage and objectives. == Display == Map and world completion information is individual for each [[character]] in the [[account]]. The [[Character selection screen]] displays the percentage world completion for each character. Both the world completion and zone completion for the current character are displayed using the world map ({{key|M}} key). These both include a progress bar displaying the percentage completed. Hovering the mouse over the zone name will display a popup with the zone's completion percentage, unless a new waypoint or point of interest was added since the last visit. These displays may include: * Completed and total {{map icon|heart}} [[Renown Heart]]s * Completed and total {{map icon|waypoint}} [[Waypoint]]s * Completed and total {{map icon|poi}} [[Point of Interest|Points of Interest]] * Completed and total {{map icon|hero}} [[Hero Challenge]]s * Completed and total {{map icon|vista}} [[Vista]]s There are account-wide achievements related to map completion, which may be displayed in the [[Hero panel]] with the tab Achievements → General → Explorer. They are each worth a total of 25 ({{ap}}) [[Achievement Points]]. * [[Ascalon Explorer]] * [[Krytan Explorer]] * [[Maguuma Explorer]] * [[Shiverpeak Explorer]] Another account-wide achievement for world completion may be displayed in the [[Hero panel]] with the tab Achievements → General → Hero. it is worth a total of 20 ({{ap}}) [[Achievement Points]] and awards the [[title]] "Been there. Done that." {{bug|Usually, the icon of 100% completion [[File:Map Explored 100%.png|24px]] for any completed map is shown on the [[loading screen]] near the map name. However, on the first loading screen, when the selected character enters the game world, this icon is missed.}} == Reward == === Explorable zones === Rewards for completion of explorable zones scale up to the top level of that zone. For example, the map completion of [[Fireheart Rise]] can give rewards up to level 70. In addition, the [[rarity]] of the items received scale with the level of that zone, from [[Item#Rarity|Masterwork]] to [[Item#Rarity|Rare]] to [[Item#Rarity|Exotic]]. * [[Coin]]s (amount scales with the level of the area) * {{experience}} [[Experience]] (10% of level at the time map was completed) * 2 random pieces of [[equipment]] (approximate to level of the area) * 40 random [[crafting material]]s, 40 map [[Currency]] or 20 random [[ingredient]]s available in the zone * Either 1 {{item icon|Transmutation Charge (item)|Transmutation Charge}} or 1 {{item icon|Black Lion Chest Key}} (except for [[Southsun Cove]])[[Game updates/2015-12-01#General|December 1st, 2015 Game Update]]. ** [[Map completion/Drop Rate|Drop rate research]] suggests that there is a ~30% chance to get a Black Lion Chest Key. ** Black Lion Chest Keys for level 80 maps are rewarded only to level 80 characters.[[Game updates/2021-05-25#General|May 25th, 2021 Game Update]] The experience reward is based on the character's level at the time of map completion regardless of when the chest is opened. ;Reward rarity and tier per zone

Cove]]. * [[Claw Island]], as it is a story instance only. === Reward === [[File:World completion reward screen.jpg|thumb|200px|Reward window for world completion]] Upon completing the last map required for world completion, a world completion icon will pop up next to the chest icon. In addition to the regular rewards for completion of the last map, players will receive: * 2 [[Gift of Exploration|Gifts of Exploration]] (for full completion on one character) * A gold star on the character's [[nameplate]] (only for the character that achieved full completion), viewable by other players * Account-wide achievement {{achievement icon|Hero_(achievements)#achievement137|Been There, Done That}} and the eponymous [[title]]. {{bug| * Some players reported that they did not receive the reward when they obtained the world completion achievement. For some, revisiting the [[Chantry of Secrets]] resolved the issue. A few were able to work around the issue by revisiting every map on the required list. Another fix is to go through the Asura gate in Lion's Arch to Black Citadel. If you encounter this issue and are not able to fix it on your own, you will have to contact [https://support.guildwars2.com ArenaNet support]. * If a character has attained map completion for a zone, and that zone, at a later date, has new items added, those new items need to be discovered in order to unlock the achievement, but not in order to get the world completion reward chest. }} == Commonly missed areas == [[File:Undiscovered area.jpg|thumb|Undiscovered area shown on mini-map.]] [[File:Unexplored area.jpg|x128px|thumb|Undiscovered area shown on main screen.]] All of the locations listed here contain map completion objectives—see [[Explorer#Commonly missed areas|the related section on the Explorer article]] for commonly missed areas with no objectives that don't contribute towards map completion. If an area has been missed on a map, that area will be marked on both the main screen and the minimap with [[File:Undiscovered area.png|25px|Undiscovered area icon]]. Both areas have a fog of war, and are associated with an indicator. For the [[Graphical user interface#Compass|mini-map]]: if the undiscovered area is outside the player's mini-map visibility, the indicator will show at the edge of the mini-map, in the required direction of travel.
